definitions.full: H3389. Yerushalaim or Yerushalayim יְרוּשָׁלַ֫יִם יֲרוּשָׁלַ֫םִ, 644 proper name, of a location Jerusalem (in Assyrian Urusalim, Tel Amarna, Zim ZA, 1891, 252, 254 ; Ursalimmu , COT Glossary ; ᵐ5 Ιερουσαλημ ; √ and meaning dubious; Rel Ew and others derive from שׁלם יְרוּשׁ possession of peace (or Salem's possession ); Thes and others from יָרָה , i.e. יְרוּ + שָׁלֵם a foundation of peace ; Grill ZAW, 1884, 134 ff. foundation of Shalem (Shalem = God of peace, = ׳י ); but name not certainly Hebrew; according to Sayce Acad. Feb. 7, 1891, 138; Higher Crit. 176 (opposed by Zim ZA. 1891, 263 ), Jastr JBL xi, 1892, 185 = Uru ( city ) + Salim , proper name, of divinity); — usually יְרוּשָׁלַ֫םִ ( Qr perpetuum ), Josh 10:10 +; יְרוּשָׁלָ֑םִ 1Sam 17:54 +; לַ֫יִם -5t. according to Masora (see Frensdorff Mass. Magna, 293 ), namely Jer 26:18 ; 1Chr 3:5 ; 2Chr 25:1 ; 32:9 (with ה locative), Est 2:6 , (but לָ֑֫םִ - 1Chr 3:5 van d. H Baer), so Maccabean coins, Levy Geschichte. d. jüd. Münz. 42 f. ; with ה locative יְרוּשָׁלַ֫מֳה 1Kin 10:2 ; Isa 36:2 ; Ezek 8:3 ; ( לַ֫יְמָה - 2Chr 32:9 above); לָ֑מֳה - 2Kin 9:28 ; with prefixes: ׳בִּירו 2Sam 9:13 +; ׳לִירו 2Kin 18:22 +; ׳מִירו 2Sam 15:11 +; ׳וִירו 2Kin 23:1 +; — Jerusalem , renowned as capital of all Israel, afterwards of southern kingdom, seat of central worship in temple, first named as city of Canaanite Adoni-‚edek Josh 10:1 , 3 , 5 , 23 (all J E), compare 12:10 (D); inhabited by Jebusites 15:63 (twice in verse) (P), Judg 1:21 (twice in verse), compare 1:7 (Adoni-Bezek); identification with יְבוּס 19:10 , and הַיְבוּסִי (q. v.) Josh 15:8 ; 18:28 (both P); captured by Judah Judg 1:8 ; first named in connection with David 1Sam 17:54 ; taken possession of by David as king 2Sam 5:6 ; David's royal seat 5:5 ; 5:13 ; 5:14 ; 8:7 ; 11:1 +; it remained the capital until taken by Nebuchadrezzar, B.C. 588, 2Kin 25:1 +; it became the chief home of the returned exiles Ezra 1:11 ; 2:11 ; Neh 2:11 , 17 +; mentioned Samuel 31 t., Kings 92 t., Chronicles 151 t., Ezra 25 t., Nehemiah 38 t., Isa 1 27t., Isa 2, 3 22t., Jeremiah 107 t., Ezekiel 26 t., Zechariah 41 t., etc. — See also proper name, of a location שָׁלֵם יְבוּס, . ירח (√ of following; meaning dubious; according to MV Buhl = ארח , of moon as wanderer , so Lag BN 46 ).
